name: Astral Core Memory
description: Offline-first AI memory with surprise-gated learning, briefing cards, and importance scoring. No API keys required. Three-tier memory lifecycle, local embeddings via llama.cpp, and optional fleet sync through Orbital Fortress.

serverUrl.description: Astral Core Memory API server URL

autoCapture.description: Automatically capture memories from conversations. Memories pass through the surprise gate — only novel information is stored.

autoRecall.description: Automatically inject relevant memories into prompts before each agent turn.

maxRecallMemories.description: Maximum memories to inject per prompt. Higher values give more context but use more tokens.

minSimilarity.description: Minimum cosine similarity threshold for memory recall (0.0-1.0). Default raised from 0.3 to 0.45 in v2.0.0 to reduce noisy dormant reactivation at scale.

captureMinMessages.description: Minimum messages in a turn before attempting capture. Prevents storing greetings.

captureMaxChars.description: Maximum characters per message to send for capture. Truncates very long responses.

briefingCardOnStart.description: Inject a briefing card at the start of each session. The card is a ≤200 token summary of identity facts, active project context, and category health. Requires memory server v2.5.0+.

briefingMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens for the briefing card. Higher values give more context at session start.

fortressUrl.description: Orbital Fortress URL for cross-device fleet sync. Leave empty to disable. Example: https://memory.orbitalfortress.com

healthCheckOnStart.description: Check memory server health when plugin loads. Logs a warning if unreachable.
